USE nyc_taxi_gold;
GO

-- ==============================================================================
-- 1. Weather Impact on Volume and Revenue
-- ==============================================================================
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_weather_impact AS
SELECT
    w.weather_category,
    d.year,                         
    d.month,                        
    d.month_name,
    CONCAT(d.month_name, ' ', d.year) AS month_year,  
    COUNT(*) AS trip_count,
    SUM(f.total_amount) AS total_revenue,
    AVG(f.total_amount) AS avg_fare,
    AVG(f.trip_duration_seconds) AS avg_duration_seconds
FROM dbo.fact_trips f
JOIN dbo.dim_weather w ON f.weather_key = w.weather_key
JOIN dbo.dim_date d ON f.pickup_date_key = d.date_key
GROUP BY w.weather_category, d.year, d.month, d.month_name;
GO

-- ==============================================================================
-- 2. Demand Heatmap (with pickup_hour)
-- ==============================================================================

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_demand_heatmap AS
SELECT
    ISNULL(f.pickup_hour, -1) AS pickup_hour,           -- Handle NULL
    ISNULL(l.borough, 'Unknown') AS borough,
    ISNULL(d.year, 0) AS year,
    ISNULL(d.month, 0) AS month,
    ISNULL(d.month_name, 'Unknown') AS month_name,
    CONCAT(ISNULL(d.month_name, 'Unknown'), ' ', ISNULL(CAST(d.year AS VARCHAR), 'Unknown')) AS month_year,
    ISNULL(d.day_name, 'Unknown') AS day_name,
    ISNULL(d.day_of_week, 0) AS day_of_week,
    ISNULL(d.is_weekend, 0) AS is_weekend,
    COUNT(*) AS trip_count,
    SUM(ISNULL(f.total_amount, 0)) AS total_revenue
FROM dbo.fact_trips f
JOIN dbo.dim_location l ON f.pickup_location_key = l.location_key
JOIN dbo.dim_date d ON f.pickup_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE l.is_current = 1
GROUP BY f.pickup_hour, l.borough, d.year, d.month, d.month_name, d.day_name, d.day_of_week, d.is_weekend;

GO

-- ==============================================================================
-- 3. Tipping Patterns
-- ==============================================================================

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_tipping_patterns AS
SELECT
    w.weather_category,
    l.borough,
    d.is_weekend,
    COUNT(*) AS trip_count,
    AVG(ISNULL(f.tip_amount, 0)) AS avg_tip,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ISNULL(f.fare_amount, 0) > 0 THEN CAST(ISNULL(f.tip_amount, 0) AS FLOAT) / CAST(f.fare_amount AS FLOAT) ELSE NULL END) AS avg_tip_pct
FROM dbo.fact_trips f
LEFT JOIN dbo.dim_weather w ON f.weather_key = w.weather_key
LEFT JOIN dbo.dim_location l ON f.pickup_location_key = l.location_key
LEFT JOIN dbo.dim_date d ON f.pickup_date_key = d.date_key
GROUP BY w.weather_category, l.borough, d.is_weekend;
GO

-- ==============================================================================
-- 4. Revenue Efficiency: $/mile vs $/minute by borough
-- ==============================================================================

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_revenue_efficiency AS
SELECT
    l.borough,
    AVG(f.total_amount / NULLIF(f.trip_distance, 0)) AS avg_revenue_per_mile,
    AVG(f.total_amount / NULLIF(f.trip_duration_seconds / 60.0, 0)) AS avg_revenue_per_minute,
    COUNT(*) AS trip_count
FROM dbo.fact_trips f
JOIN dbo.dim_location l ON f.pickup_location_key = l.location_key
WHERE l.is_current = 1
GROUP BY l.borough;
GO
